races.name: Aspire Cleaning & Facilities Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Westport
runners_data.note: Front runner with clear class edge who should dictate a comfortable pace with no pressure from these rivals
runners_data.comment: Carries all the penalties but impossible to oppose given the level reached already
runners_data.spotlight: 270,000gns yearling by Blue Point; his wins have been over 6f (AW/good) but dropping back to 5f shouldn't be remotely troublesome in this company and the Godolphin horse he beat last time had won a Newmarket maiden; carries all the penalties but impossible to oppose.

runners_data.name: Sanny Doo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has finished last in both recent starts and needs major improvement to be competitive
runners_data.comment: Has finished last in both his races, latterly well behind You Mystify Me
runners_data.spotlight: Finished last in one start for James Tate and suffered the same fate on debut for this yard at Doncaster when a long way behind You Mystify Me; the hood tried there is removed.

runners_data.name: You Mystify Me
runners_data.note: Unproven type with one run for current connections but showed some ability when third at Doncaster over this trip
runners_data.comment: Posted an RPR in the 50s when a remote third at Doncaster (5f, good to firm)
runners_data.spotlight: Posted an RPR in the 50s when a remote third at Doncaster (5f, good to firm); looks good for second spot but unlikely to be troubling the favourite.

runners_data.name: Supremissy
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has shown little ability in completed starts and carries the 'fades in finish' warning
runners_data.comment: Has shown very little in her two completed starts and instantly opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown very little in her two completed starts and instantly opposable.

races.paceDynamic: Westport is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and should get an uncontested lead with the other three holding more patient tactics. You Mystify Me may try to track the leader but Sanny Doo and Supremissy are likely to be held up early. With no pace pressure on Westport, he can dictate fractions and kick when ready over this sharp 5f trip. This race shape strongly favours the front runner who can control the tempo and has the class edge over his rivals.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Westport Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Westport gets a soft lead and kicks at the right moment
scenarios.body: He can dictate comfortable fractions and use his superior class (OR 96) to pull away when asked. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Surprise Challenge Late
scenarios.trigger: If You Mystify Me or Sanny Doo produces career-best efforts
scenarios.body: One of the hold-up horses could benefit from the steady pace and deliver a late challenge. However, they would need significant improvement to match Westport's proven level.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Westport Stops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite fails to see out the trip or ties up
scenarios.body: His previous wins have been over 6f, so if the drop to 5f doesn't suit he could be vulnerable late. You Mystify Me would be best placed to capitalize from his tracking position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Westport goes too slow early and gets swamped
scenarios.body: A crawling pace could set up a sprint finish where anything might happen. This would theoretically give the hold-up horses their best chance but their form profiles suggest limited ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Westport gets headed in the straight - his class advantage should prevent this happening
Monitor You Mystify Me's early position as she needs to track the pace to have any chance of placing
Check if Sanny Doo shows more early pace than usual given his poor recent form when held up
Watch for any late market moves on You Mystify Me who remains relatively unexposed for the Easterby team

races.name: Heineken Buttonhook Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Square Necker
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from 72-day break with clear tactical advantage and strong debut form that has worked out well
runners_data.comment: When second to Constitution Hill at Southwell (1m4f novice) he was giving the winner 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: 160,000euros yearling; his debut third in a 1m2f Doncaster maiden last March (good to soft) worked out exceptionally well and he then won easily at Dundalk in December (1m4f; odds-on; had been gelded), at the expense of a Listed-placed rival; could be on a useful mark for handicap debut and when second to Constitution Hill at Southwell (1m4f novice) he was giving the winner 5lb.

runners_data.name: Elysian Flame
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for new connections with solid staying form and quick 18-day turnaround suggesting readiness
runners_data.comment: Second run since 2021 when winning well over 2m at Beverley last month; up 2lb
runners_data.spotlight: Smart staying handicapper on the Flat for Mick and David Easterby in 2021 when competitive at some of the major meetings; having only his second run since that year when winning well over 2m at Beverley last month (good to soft); still useful, clearly, and has only gone up 2lb.

runners_data.name: Galyx
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long 312-day absence but showed winning form last time and trainer is 5/14 recently

runners_data.name: Humble Spark
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer much better on all-weather surfaces than turf and faces difficult tactical scenario from rear
runners_data.comment: Respectable runs of late at Musselburgh but wouldn't be the obvious answer
runners_data.spotlight: Exposed 6yo who is 7-27 on AW surfaces but 1-12 on turf; respectable runs of late at Musselburgh but wouldn't be the obvious answer.

runners_data.name: Baileys Khelstar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good current form with useful 7lb weight advantage and solid recent placed efforts

runners_data.name: Mountain Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning quickly from just okay comeback run and faces uphill task from the back in small field
runners_data.comment: Last week's comeback run at Musselburgh was just okay (2m, good); others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: 4-15 for David Simcock; absent for 582 days after a heavy defeat on debut for this yard and last week's comeback run at Musselburgh was just okay (2m, good); others preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Square Necker will set the pace from the front with no other natural leaders in this small field. Elysian Flame, Galyx, and Baileys Khelstar will settle in behind the leader in prominent positions, while the two hold-up horses Humble Spark and Mountain Road will drop to the rear. With only one front runner and three prominent racers, Square Necker should get an uncontested lead and controlled fractions over this stamina test. This tactical setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the pace, as the two hold-up horses will face a difficult task from the back of a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Square Necker gets easy fractions on the front end
scenarios.body: The four-year-old controls every call and has enough in reserve to resist late challenges over this trip that suits. His class edge from that exceptional Doncaster third shows through when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can improve on Square Necker's kick
scenarios.body: Elysian Flame or Galyx travel strongly behind the leader before pouncing in the final two furlongs when the pace lifts. Their higher ratings and tactical advantage over the hold-up pair prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Humble Spark or Mountain Road benefit from a crawling pace that sets up their closing kicks perfectly. The front runners stop and the race becomes about who has the most left in the tank.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If moderate early fractions create an even contest throughout
scenarios.body: The race develops into a fair test where ratings matter most, allowing any of the prominent racers to strike. Baileys Khelstar's recent form and weight advantage become telling factors.

watchPoints.text: Square Necker could get uncontested fractions and prove hard to peg back if jumping cleanly from the gates
Humble Spark and Mountain Road need the pace to collapse early to have any realistic winning chance from their hold-up styles
Galyx returning from 312-day layoff could need the run despite winning form last time out
Small six-runner field increases the importance of early positioning and reduces opportunities for hold-up horses
Elysian Flame's quick turnaround from 18 days ago suggests connections are happy with current condition

races.name: Darley Stallions EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Conclave
runners_data.note: Front runner with highest rating but faces another confirmed leader in small field which creates tactical complications
runners_data.comment: Awarded debut race; better again when second to a class act back at Kempton
runners_data.spotlight: Awarded his debut race after the first past the post weighed in light and that rival impressed next time out; this gelding also took a sizeable step forward back at Kempton (1m) when a clear second behind yesterday's 2,000 Guineas contender King's Trail; faces some interesting opponents here but might be up to the task.

runners_data.name: Ervani
runners_data.note: Prominent racer making quick reappearance after debut second, perfectly positioned to benefit if leaders clash
runners_data.comment: Only made his debut last week when runner-up to a 1-4 chance at Wetherby; can improve
runners_data.spotlight: Only made his debut last week when runner-up to a 1-4 chance at Wetherby (1m, good to firm); a line through the third gives him a fair bit to find with Conclave but this colt is clearly open to improvement.

runners_data.name: Haayimm
runners_data.note: Recently gelded prominent runner returning after 26 days with proven form over similar conditions
runners_data.comment: Beat a disappointing fav at Pontefract but this gelding is very much unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: Gelded after last season's run; highly unlikely that the 1-8 favourite gave his running when this son of Gleneagles beat him at Pontefract (1m, good to soft) but he's a well-bred improver and unexposed.

runners_data.name: Proud Nation
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning from 238-day absence with sharp 7f pedigree stepping up significantly in trip
runners_data.comment: Sharp pedigree but was confined to 7f last season and made all second time out at York
runners_data.spotlight: Sharp pedigree but was confined to 7f last season and made all second time out at York (good); mixed messages as to the strength of that form but he appeals as the type to do well as a 3yo.

races.paceDynamic: Conclave and Proud Nation are confirmed front runners who will clash from the gates in this small field. With both needing to lead, they'll engage early and create an honest gallop over this staying trip at Hamilton. Ervani and Haayimm can track from prominent positions but the leaders will dictate terms. This contested pace strongly favours the prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can capitalise on the front runners' duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Conclave and Proud Nation engage in a pace duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: The front runners will weaken in the final furlong after their sustained battle, allowing the prominent racers to sweep past. Ervani and Haayimm are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their tracking styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Conclave Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Conclave can assert superiority over Proud Nation early and dictate terms
scenarios.body: The class leader settles the pace argument quickly and controls the race from the front without serious pressure. His superior rating and form gives him the quality edge when allowed an easy lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Proud Nation Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Proud Nation's 238-day break has freshened him significantly and he outbattles Conclave
scenarios.body: The Irish raider's sharpness advantage and York winning form translates effectively to this longer trip. His front-running style proves more effective than anticipated against the higher-rated opposition.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Haayimm Benefits From Gelding
scenarios.trigger: If the recent gelding operation has significantly improved Haayimm's focus and attitude
scenarios.body: The Pontefract winner shows marked improvement from his quieter racing style and overtakes the pace-pressed leaders. His previous victory over a short-priced favourite demonstrates hidden ability that the operation unlocks.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Conclave and Proud Nation both attempt to lead from the start as neither will want to settle behind
Monitor Proud Nation's stamina reserves over this extended trip given his sharp breeding and 7f background
Observe Haayimm's early behaviour to assess whether the gelding operation has improved his racing attitude
Check Ervani's jumping from the gates as quick early speed will be crucial in this tactical battle

races.paceDynamic: Native Instinct emerges as the sole confirmed front runner, positioned to dictate proceedings from the outset without early pressure. With seven of eight runners showing hold-up tendencies (Starliner, Polygram, Arkenstaar, Native Honey, Izzari, Quiet Resolve, plus unproven Sanafi Zabeel), this creates a tactical disadvantage for the closers who must rely on Native Instinct providing enough tempo. The pace-setter controls the race completely, able to dictate fractions and inject pace when it suits. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and the lone pace-setter Native Instinct, who can exploit the tactical gift of an uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Native Instinct Dominates Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Native Instinct gets soft fractions uncontested early
scenarios.body: He can quicken at will from the front while the massed ranks of hold-up horses get in each other's way turning for home. The pace-setter exploits perfect positioning while closers struggle for racing room and momentum.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Quality
scenarios.trigger: If one closer produces exceptional acceleration despite the pace scenario
scenarios.body: A hold-up horse with genuine class overcomes the tactical disadvantage through superior ability and finds gaps when others cannot. The winner needs both quality and racing luck.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Muddling Pace Helps Stalkers
scenarios.trigger: If Native Instinct goes too slowly and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: The gentle tempo allows multiple closers to get competitive, creating a cavalry charge finish where the best stayer prevails. Superior stamina becomes the deciding factor over tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Creates Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Native Instinct stops completely or the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of rating or form. Random positioning and jockey judgement matter more than ability.

watchPoints.text: Native Instinct's early positioning - if he breaks alertly and settles in front uncontested, he becomes extremely difficult to peg back
The start and early positioning of Sanafi Zabeel - any signs of pace ability could completely change the race dynamic
Traffic problems turning for home when seven hold-up horses all need racing room simultaneously in the straight
Native Instinct's jumping from the stalls after 187 days off - a sluggish break could allow others to press him early
How aggressively the hold-up horses' jockeys ride in the early stages - any early positioning battle changes everything

races.paceDynamic: With Glory is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will lead from the start without early pressure. The prominent runners (Simba's Pride, Cosmic Clarets, Breeze Star) will settle just behind while the hold-up horses (Liverpool Star, Realistic Dream, Ellie's de Vega, Dandy Orton) track from the rear. With Glory can dictate a comfortable pace over 6f at Hamilton, creating a scenario where the leaders can kick clear in the straight before the closers get organized. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent/early positioned horses who can track With Glory and strike in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If With Glory gets an easy lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: With Glory can control the tempo completely and kick clear when ready, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back in a small field. The front runner's class edge emerges late when not under early pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuine in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The prominent runners tracking With Glory get first run on the leader and exploit their handy positions, with Liverpool Star's recent Ripon win form proving decisive from his hold-up style. The pace lifts just enough to set up the trackers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and collapses
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses benefit from a pace meltdown as With Glory and the prominent group go too fast early, allowing Ellie's de Vega or Realistic Dream to sweep past tired leaders. The sprint finish suits the fresh closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites underperform due to pace positioning errors
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy tactically with false pace or bunching, creating opportunities for improved horses like Breeze Star with tongue-tie or Dandy Orton under new trainer. Form gets turned upside down.

watchPoints.text: With Glory could steal this if getting uncontested lead and dictating comfortable fractions throughout
Liverpool Star needs pace development to be effective from hold-up position in this small field
Cosmic Clarets' finishing kick may not materialize again if pace becomes genuinely testing
First-time headgear on Breeze Star and Dandy Orton under new connections could spark improvement
The prominent runners Simba's Pride and Cosmic Clarets are best positioned tactically to track the likely leader

races.paceDynamic: Digital and Until Dawn will dispute the early lead in this 5f handicap, with Digital the more reliable front runner having won three AW sprints through winter. Hi Lord and Ganesha should sit prominent behind the pace battle, while the majority including Mount Ruapehu, Opal Storm, Thunderstorm Katie and Sir Benedict will attempt to pick up the pieces from hold-up positions. With two committed pace setters likely to ensure honest fractions over this stiff Hamilton 5f, the race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish late and exploit the likely collapse of the early leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Digital and Until Dawn duel early and weaken markedly in final furlong
scenarios.body: The strong early pace sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Mount Ruapehu, Opal Storm and Thunderstorm Katie all possess the tactical speed to capitalize on this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Digital breaks cleanly and gets uncontested lead with Until Dawn slow away
scenarios.body: Digital could steal a march and hold on if given an easy time up front. His three winter wins prove he has the class when things go his way.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hi Lord or Ganesha track the pace perfectly without getting involved early
scenarios.body: The prominent pair can avoid the early battle while staying close enough to strike. Ganesha showed signs of returning form at Newcastle last time.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If pace collapses completely and longer-priced hold-up horse produces career-best
scenarios.body: King Of The Jungle or Sir Benedict could exploit a truly run race at big odds. Both have shown ability in the past and are weighted to be competitive.

watchPoints.text: Colour Code often misses the break and refused to race last time, making her elimination-worthy
Digital must break alertly to secure uncontested lead, any tardiness from stalls will compromise chances significantly
Mount Ruapehu carries top-weight but arrives in excellent form with three recent wins over sprint distances
Until Dawn wears hood after wind operation but recent form suggests the procedure hasn't helped her performance
Several runners including Midnight Lir, King Of The Jungle and Sixcor return after extended breaks exceeding 200 days

races.name: Racing TV Handicap

runners_data.name: Monsieur Melee
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making stable debut after 616 days off, but his consistent summer 2024 form suggests class remains intact
runners_data.comment: In good form for Jedd O'Keeffe in summer 2024; makes stable debut after long absence
runners_data.spotlight: Changed hands for 45,000gns after string of good efforts for Jedd O'Keeffe in summer 2024, but this stable debut has been a long time coming and he might come on for the run.

runners_data.name: Gozo
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who should get easy lead, well-handicapped on old Flat form but question marks over recent hurdles efforts
runners_data.comment: Pulled up twice over hurdles this year; back on the Flat with lots to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Well handicapped on Flat form for Ben Brookhouse in early part of 2025, but pulled up in two handicap hurdles when owner-trained this year; now in the care of Mike Smith for Flat return; others have much less to prove.

runners_data.name: Valley Of Flowers
runners_data.note: Hold-up type in good current form with solid recent third, ideally positioned for tactical race development

runners_data.name: Newport
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning to Flat after hurdles campaign, long absence since last turf run is concerning
runners_data.comment: Not seen on Flat since 2024 but largely in good form over hurdles since the autumn
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 on the Flat when trained in Ireland and not seen in this sphere since summer 2024, but has largely been in good form over hurdles for Iain Jardine since the autumn; might be the answer.

runners_data.name: Alpine Sierra
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent current form with three recent seconds, just four days since last encouraging effort
runners_data.comment: Second three times on AW in March and also ran well when back on turf on Wednesday
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up three consecutive times on Tapeta in March (1m-1m2f) and returned to turf with pretty good third at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) on Wednesday; should be fine over this longer trip; probably won't be far away.

runners_data.name: Taylormade Lad
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 206-day break, previous Carlisle win shows ability but fitness unknown
runners_data.comment: Won over this trip at Carlisle last summer; has fitness to prove but not yet fully exposed
runners_data.spotlight: Came good with narrow win at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) last summer, his seventh start; absent since disappointing AW run in first-time cheekpieces (retained) in October but has scope for progress this year.

runners_data.name: Jaminoz
runners_data.note: Four-time course winner but recent hurdles form suggests significant decline from peak powers
runners_data.comment: Four-time course winner; below form over hurdles in late 2025; best on slower ground
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time course winner, most recently over today's trip (good to soft) in September; ended 2025 with two below-par hurdle runs, though, and would appeal more on ground slower than good.

runners_data.name: Ned Broy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner stepping back to handicaps, recent maiden hurdle efforts suggest limited current ability
runners_data.comment: Made fairly encouraging handicap debut in January; safely held in three hurdles since
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three maiden/novice hurdles since February, but made fairly encouraging Flat handicap debut when keeping-on sixth at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in January and remains unexposed; worth a glance in the betting.

races.paceDynamic: Gozo is the only confirmed front runner and will take this field along at a sustainable pace with no pressure from the gate. Alpine Sierra and Taylormade Lad can sit prominent, but neither has the pure speed to challenge Gozo early. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial in the straight. This scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll get the perfect setup behind an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady as expected with Gozo unchallenged early
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to get into perfect rhythm and unleash telling finishes when it matters. Valley Of Flowers and Monsieur Melee benefit most from this patient tactical approach.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Alpine Sierra or Taylormade Lad can improve position turning for home
scenarios.body: Recent form suggests Alpine Sierra could capitalise on her current fitness edge to track closer than usual. Her three consecutive seconds show she's peaking at the right time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Gozo Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite's class tells and he maintains gallop to the line
scenarios.body: His handicap mark suggests he's well-treated returning to the Flat after hurdles disappointments. The uncontested lead gives him every chance to dictate terms throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Course Specialist Delivers
scenarios.trigger: If Jaminoz can recapture his best Hamilton form despite poor recent efforts
scenarios.body: His four course wins include one over today's trip, but his hurdles form suggests he's regressed significantly. Would need everything to fall right.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Alpine Sierra travels strongly early - her current form peak could see her track closer than usual to the leaders
Monitor Gozo's jumping from the stalls - any sluggish start would disrupt his front-running tactics completely
Check how Monsieur Melee handles the return after 616 days - stable debut following long absence needs close observation
Observe Valley Of Flowers' position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance to utilise her finishing kick
Watch for any market moves on Newport given his dual-purpose trainer's solid strike rate
